cr_data.provenance: Estate of Artist, 1986 (Source: Brooklyn Museum of Art, 2025)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 13, 1946. . . . No signature." Whitney Archive indicates, "On backing: Label, 'Red Hills with Pedernal – New Mexico' 1936 [not verified]. Note: Miss O'Keeffe says this was in 1937 exhibition at Amer. Place but not listed in catalogue." Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Back: A.S.: 'Red Hills with Pedernal – New Mexico.' 1936. (pastel) Georgia O'Keeffe." Inscription in museum files: "'Red Hills with Pedernal –/New Mexico' – 1936/(pastel)/Georgia O'Keeffe/From An American Place/509 Madison Ave New York/N.Y." (Alfred Stieglitz, black ink). Not exhibited until 1937–38 New York (An American Place) exhibition. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Red Hills with the Pedernal

description: Reddish-brown hills sweep across the lower portion of the composition. A few green trees poke out from behind the hills, and the blue form of Pedernal rises above. Stretching over the landscape is a clouded daytime sky.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Brooklyn Museum of Art.
